items.title: Weekly Cybersecurity News Recap : Tenable, Qualys, Workday Data Breaches and Security Updates
items.description: This week in cybersecurity serves as a critical reminder of the pervasive risks within the digital supply chain, as several industry-leading companies disclosed significant data breaches. The incidents, affecting vulnerability management giants Tenable and Qualys, as well as enterprise software provider Workday, all stemmed from a security flaw in a common third-party service. items.title: FBI Unveils IOCs for Cyber Attacks Targeting Salesforce Instances for Data Exfiltration
items.description: The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) has released a flash alert detailing the activities of two cybercriminal groups, UNC6040 and UNC6395, that are actively compromising Salesforce environments to steal data for extortion purposes.
